DIMENSIONSMOD-RED_GIANT.description: At the start of each combat, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a random card in your hand.
DIMENSIONSMOD-RED_GIANT.flavor: A dying star, swollen with unstable power.
DIMENSIONSMOD-RED_GIANT.title: Red Giant
DIMENSIONSMOD-BLACK_HOLE.description: At the start of each combat, draw [blue]2[/blue] additional cards and choose a card in your hand to [gold]Play[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
DIMENSIONSMOD-BLACK_HOLE.flavor: You can use it to eat your garbage.
DIMENSIONSMOD-BLACK_HOLE.title: Black Hole
